docs.title: POST /admin/saveRemote
docs.text:
Save Remote (Benchling or ICE)

Description

Save a new Benchling or ICE remote repository

Input parameters

Parameter In Type Default Nullable Description userToken header string N/A No Authentication token with admin privileges

Request body

application/x-www-form-urlencoded 
{
    "type": "benchling",
    "id": "my-benchling-remote",
    "url": "https://benchling.com/api",
    "benchlingApiToken": "sk_live_abc123",
    "isPublic": "true",
    "rootCollectionDisplayId": "benchling_collection",
    "rootCollectionName": "Benchling Collection",
    "rootCollectionDescription": "Remotely accessed Benchling parts"
}
Schema of the request body 
{
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
        "type": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
                "benchling",
                "ice"
            ],
            "description": "Type of the remote (Benchling or ICE)"
        },
        "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "Id of the remote"
        },
        "url": {
            "type": "string",
            "format": "uri",
            "description": "URL for the remote"
        },
        "benchlingApiToken": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "API token for the Benchling remote (required if type is benchling)"
        },
        "iceApiTokenClient": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "ICE API token client (required if type is ice)"
        },
        "iceApiToken": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "ICE API token (required if type is ice)"
        },
        "iceApiTokenOwner": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "ICE API token owner (required if type is ice)"
        },
        "iceCollection": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "ICE collection"
        },
        "rejectUnauthorized": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
                "true",
                "false"
            ],
            "description": "Whether to check SSL certificate",
            "default": "true"
        },
        "folderPrefix": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "Prefix to use for folders on the remote"
        },
        "sequenceSuffix": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "Suffix to use for sequences found on the remote"
        },
        "defaultFolderId": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "Default folder on the remote to access"
        },
        "groupId": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "Group id on ICE"
        },
        "pi": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "Principal Investigator name (ICE)"
        },
        "piEmail": {
            "type": "string",
            "format": "email",
            "description": "Principal Investigator email (ICE)"
        },
        "isPublic": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
                "true",
                "false"
            ],
            "description": "Should the remote be visible publicly?",
            "default": "true"
        },
        "partNumberPrefix": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "Prefix to use for parts (ICE)"
        },
        "rootCollectionDisplayId": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "Display id for the root collection on the remote"
        },
        "rootCollectionName": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "Name for the root collection on the remote"
        },
        "rootCollectionDescription": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "Description for the root collection on the remote"
        }
    },
    "required": [
        "type",
        "id"
    ]
}

Responses

200 OK401 Unauthorized403 Forbidden

docs.title: SynBioHub Plugins
docs.text: Plugins allow you to extend SynBioHub's functionality without modifying the core codebase. They are standalone web services that SynBioHub communicates with via a standardized API.

docs.title: Plugin Types
docs.text:
1. Rendering Plugins: Used to visualize objects (e.g., VisBol for SBOL diagrams).
  2. Submit Plugins: Used to process data during the submission process (e.g., converting non-SBOL files).
  3. Download Plugins: Used to export data into different formats.
  4. Mail Plugins: Used to handle custom email notifications.

docs.title: Requirements
docs.text:
All plugins must implement three core endpoints: - GET /status: Returns whether the plugin is operational. - POST /evaluate: Determines if the plugin can handle a specific object or file. - POST /run: Executes the plugin logic.

For more details on implementing these, see the Plugins API documentation.

docs.title: External Remotes
docs.text: Remotes allow SynBioHub to interact with external biological data repositories, enabling users to import data or search across distributed instances.

docs.title: Benchling
docs.text: Integration with Benchling allows you to browse and import sequences directly into your SynBioHub collections. You'll need a Benchling API token to configure this.

docs.title: ICE (Inventory of Composable Elements)
docs.text: Integration with ICE instances allows for seamless data exchange between your local registry and an ICE-based repository.

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text: Remotes are configured via the Administration API. Admins can: - Add new Benchling or ICE remotes. - Set visibility (Public vs. Private). - Configure SSL certificate validation.
